title: Synthesize minimal CCP policy proposal
description: Produce source-linked Probably Right Thing recommendation separating link-quality SF selection, receiver rendezvous, density-aware control traffic and airtime congestion admission. Keep proposed wire/scheduling changes distinct from settled decisions; avoid invented numeric thresholds, perfect scheduling claims and new negotiation frameworks.
acceptance_criteria: Proposal covers ordinary single-radio mesh and stronger gateway capabilities, fallback/desync, bounded queues and priorities, regulatory accounting, metrics uncertainty, and cheapest initial corrective revision; no spec edits or adjudication claim.
